address: via Henry Dunant 1, San Fermo della Battaglia, 22020, Italy
bio: A young and passionate professional couple has taken the helm of this modern and welcoming establishment, offering a gastronomic line inspired by sustainability, seasonality, herbs harvested directly by them, and ingredients from the mountains but also from the sea, as long as they come from trusted producers who respect nature and animals. On some Sundays, foraging in the surrounding woods is offered, ending with a lunch where the harvested herbs are used....
